content.short: ImmutableX provides a layer-2 scaling solution for games and NFTs on Ethereum with low gas fees for minting and trading.
content.description: ImmutableX is a layer-2 scaling solution for NFTs on Ethereum that focuses on speed, cost, and security. It enables near-instant trade confirmation and near-zero gas fees for minting and trading NFTs, while preserving the security and ownership of user assets and avoiding compromises to funds during transfers. Developers can leverage ImmutableX to scale NFT applications, including marketplaces, wallets, and games, without changing their existing onboarding or user experience. NFTs can be bought, sold, and minted on marketplaces built on ImmutableX, providing broad marketplace interoperability and efficient asset transfer.
